verdict.rationale: The quickstart says you can chat with a running llamafile through the bundled llama.cpp Web UI by opening http://localhost:8080/ in a browser. The CLI reference lists dedicated Web UI options, and a community user praises the "web server with chat" UX, which corroborates that the interface exists and works. missing for 10: documentation of the chat UI's feature depth (conversation history, settings, model controls), and it is a browser-served UI derived from llama.cpp rather than a native first-party app.
